_readme: CV timeline data. All values below are PLACEHOLDER — replace them.
`sections` sets the order and headings of the timeline; each entry's
`section` must match one of the section `id`s. Set `end` to "present"
for a current role — that entry gets a filled timeline dot. Omit `end`
entirely for a single-year item (an award, a service role). `bullets`
